source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega recording, background replaced by green via Segment Anything 2; watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static: phase correlation of frames vs frame 0 on the static props/table region, max |shift| 0.09 px x, 0.07 px y (scene/camera_shift.json)
camera.intrinsics_from_benchmark: HFOV 80 deg, f = 0.5959 * 1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640, 360)
camera.view: elevated oblique view looking down onto a table top; camera slightly to the right of the table centre line, table rotated so its front edge slopes down to the right in the image

perspective_cues.front_edge_thickness_px: about 29 px at left end, 35 px at right end
perspective_cues.horizon: not visible (green background); table-top side edges converge upward
perspective_cues.note: corner pixels read by eye from frames/table_check.png and a grid frame; +-3 px

ball.description: small white ball (golf/ping-pong-like, with a dark red logo on it), the only moving object
ball.visible_frames: 0-44 (44 cut by bottom image edge); absent 45-48 (fell out of frame below)
ball.reference_point: visible centre (circle fit to mask contour on table, frames 0-40; blur-streak bbox centre, frames 41-43; frame 44 estimated)

apparent_diameter_px.falling_41_44_bbox_width: 49-51 (includes horizontal blur / mask bleed; less reliable)

pink_bottle.description: tall pink insulated bottle/thermos with a lighter cap band, back-centre of table, left of the white cup

white_cup.description: white tapered tumbler/cup with a metallic rim, right of the pink bottle

leaning_cards.description: two playing cards leaning against each other / the pink bottle in front of it (front card white face with blue-grey back pattern, rear card pink-ish)
leaning_cards.front_card_px: top edge ~ (675-700, 418), bottom ~ (695-712, 497); about 22 px wide, ~80 px long along its tilted axis

flat_card.description: playing card lying flat on the table in front of the bottle/cup

black_card_phone.description: small black flat object (phone/card holder) with a yellow sticker, near the front edge left of centre

table.description: square/rectangular wooden table top (brown wood grain) on a single dark pedestal
table.front_edge_length_px: top front edge from (210,540) to (1135,584): 926 px

events.event: ball starts rolling (first sub-pixel shift at 18, clear motion at 19); pushed/released from rest out of view, direction toward camera and left (image down-left)
possible dropped capture frame: displacement 35->36 is about twice its neighbours
ball rolls off the front table edge (last on-table frame 40, first falling frame 41)
ball falling past the table edge, strong vertical motion blur
ball leaves the image through the bottom edge

files.tracks/ball_raw.csv: raw mask stats incl. centroid, ellipse and circle fits
files.static_auto.json / table_auto.json: automatic mask extents (bottle bbox there includes the pink card; prefer values above)
